name: punjab_agri_news
description: Extract headline, short summary (first 2-3 sentences if available), article URL, image URL, video URL if the article embeds a video player, publisher name, and published date from each agriculture news story on the page. Keep the article URL as-is; do not follow or store the full article body. If a video URL is present in an embed or og:video meta tag, capture it; otherwise leave null.
